descriptions.environment_date: Return the Miami-Dade Clerk portal's current server date (the date the indexer treats as 'today'). No parameters, no authentication. Returns a ServerDate object with the date string. Use this before any date-range search to align local clocks with the portal — recordings filed today are typically not searchable until the portal's next index roll, and the server date tells you what 'today' the index sees.
descriptions.environment_status: Return Miami-Dade Clerk portal availability and indexing freshness. No parameters, no authentication. Returns an EnvironmentStatus object with operational status (open / maintenance / outage) and the last recording-cutoff date — recordings filed after this date are not yet searchable. Call this before bulk searches to confirm the portal is up and to know how stale the index is.
descriptions.doc-types_list: List every recordable document type Miami-Dade Clerk indexes (~80 entries): 3-letter codes (DEE, MOR, LIS, FTL, SAT, JUD, etc.) and human-readable display labels. No parameters, no authentication. Returns an array of DocType objects. Use this to validate `documentType` filters before submitting a search, or to translate raw codes from search results into human labels.
